intro: Kuwaiti culture centres on the diwaniya, the sea and Gulf music and theatre.

chapters.title: The diwaniya
text: Men, and increasingly women, gather in diwaniyas, reception rooms where friends meet in the evening to talk about everything from football to politics.

chapters.title: Arts and food
text: Kuwaiti TV dramas and plays are popular across the Gulf. Machboos with fish or chicken is the national dish.

keyTerms.meaning: A reception room and the gatherings held in it.
